MassRobotics opens its sixth healthcare robotics catalyst cohort

Applications close December 31, with Intel joining the mentoring partners to support validation and pilot readiness.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗15 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

Open to international teams

MassRobotics opened applications for cohort six of its Healthcare Robotics Startup Catalyst Program from October 15 through December 31, 2026. The non-equity program runs from February to June 2027 and welcomes early and more mature teams worldwide, including Seed through Series C companies.

Mentoring around practical milestones

Intel joins Festo, Novanta and Mitsubishi Electric US on the steering committee, adding edge-AI and on-device computing expertise. Teams receive technical mentoring and clinical perspectives, with biweekly mentor sessions supporting prototypes, pilot design, regulatory planning or systems integration.

Fit and selection

Eligible areas include laboratories, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, hospital logistics, rehabilitation and surgical robotics. Selection considers technical maturity, clinical relevance and achievable near-term milestones. The program has mentored 35 startups since 2021, but that record is neither medical approval nor a funding guarantee for new participants.
